Riley, a full-minute clean cascade is a great target, and weekdays leave the weekends to rest. Here's the plan:
• Goal: a clean 3-ball cascade for 60 seconds
• Today's step: 15 min of one-ball tosses hand to hand, peaking at eye height, then two balls. Film the last 2 minutes.
• Schedule: Mon to Fri at 6 pm, 15 min, in an open spot at home
• Proof: a 1-2 min video of you juggling, so we can both see your progress. If filming is a hassle, a voice note on how it went works too.

Each day builds on how the last one went. We'll move to three balls once the throws feel steady, then count catches toward that full minute. What do you think?
Riley, glad it feels right. Are you officially committing to this plan: juggling Mon to Fri at 6 pm, starting today?
Let's go, Riley! 🤹 Day 1 is today at 6 pm: 15 minutes of one-ball tosses, then two balls, and film the last 2 minutes.
